name: Porto Pollo
notes: Kite zone on the Porto Liscia (west) side of the Isola dei Gabbiani isthmus; the Porto Pollo bay itself is windsurf only. Mistral (W–NW) and libeccio; schools on site.

name: Porto Botte
notes: Very shallow bay with standing depth far out: flat water, good for learning. Mistral (NW) works best.

name: Cagliari – Poetto
notes: Long city beach; works with scirocco / SE and the summer sea breeze. Summer: kite only in the designated corridors.

name: San Teodoro – La Cinta
notes: Long sandbar beach; works with levante / scirocco (onshore). Summer: kite corridor only.

name: Putzu Idu
notes: Sinis peninsula; mistral (NW) side-shore, chop to small waves. Schools on site.

name: Funtanamare
notes: Wave spot on the south-west coast; mistral (NW) cross-onshore. Experienced riders.

name: Platamona
notes: Long north-coast beach near Sassari; mistral (NW) cross-shore, chop and waves. Summer: kite corridors only.

name: Lo Stagnone (Marsala)
notes: Shallow flat-water lagoon, standing almost everywhere; many schools. Thermal / scirocco / mistral all work. Keep clear of swimming areas.

name: Mazara del Vallo – Capo Feto
notes: Wild beach next to the Capo Feto nature reserve; flat water inside the reef with W–NW, chop further out. Schools in season.

name: Gizzeria – Hang Loose Beach
notes: Very reliable thermal (W–NW) from spring to autumn, funnelled across the narrowest point of Italy. Large kite beach with schools.

name: Porto Cesareo – Torre Lapillo
notes: Ionian coast; works with W to S winds and the summer sea breeze. Summer: kite corridors only.

name: Torre Canne
notes: Adriatic beach; maestrale (NW) side-shore, flat to choppy. Summer: kite corridors only.

name: Margherita di Savoia
notes: Long shallow Adriatic beach; maestrale (NW) side-shore and thermal. Schools on site.

name: Manfredonia – Siponto
notes: Shallow beach on the Gulf of Manfredonia; summer thermal and maestrale. Flat water close in, good for learning.

name: Rosolina Mare
notes: Adriatic beach near the Po delta; bora (NE) and scirocco onshore. Summer: kite corridor only.

name: Lago di Garda – Malcesine
notes: East shore; Pelèr (N) in the morning, Ora (S) in the afternoon. Kiting on Garda is regulated (zones / times, often only via a kite centre with boat): check locally.

name: Lago di Garda – Campione
notes: Thermal winds: Pelèr (N) in the morning, Ora (S) in the afternoon. Kiting via the local kite centre (boat launch).

name: Lago di Santa Croce
notes: Small lake in the Alpago; reliable afternoon thermal in summer, Bora-type north wind in the morning. Kite schools on site.

name: Lago di Resia (Reschensee)
notes: High-altitude reservoir (about 1,500 m) with a reliable valley wind in summer; cold water, full wetsuit. Kite schools at Graun / Reschen.

name: Talamone
notes: Bay north of the Argentario; libeccio (SW) and W thermal, flat to choppy. Schools on site.
